name: Pequod's Pizza
signature: Pan pizza with the caramelised cheese crust. Add garlic and chilli.
signature_zh: 深盘焦糖芝士边，加蒜和辣椒，小红书上几乎是统一口径
why: Xiaohongshu breaks with the tourist consensus here: skip Lou Malnati's and Giordano's, come for the burnt-cheese rim that forms against the pan.
why_zh: 小红书上对深盘的共识是反游客的：别去 Lou Malnati's 和 Giordano's，来这里吃贴着烤盘焦化的那圈芝士边。
tip: In Lincoln Park, away from the tourist core. Takes reservations on Tock; walk-in waits reach two hours at peak. Bar seats move faster.
tip_zh: 在林肯公园，远离游客区。可以用 Tock 订位；现场高峰要等两小时，吧台轮得快些。

name: Au Cheval
signature: The cheeseburger. Add egg and bacon.
signature_zh: 招牌芝士汉堡，加蛋加培根
why: The single most common entry on Xiaohongshu 'didn't manage to get in' lists. The 'single' is actually a double patty.
why_zh: 小红书上出现频率最高的"没吃上"清单常客。菜单写的 single 其实是双层肉饼。
tip: Now takes limited reservations via Resy/Tock after 14 years of walk-ins only. Book if you can; walk-in waits still run two to three hours at peak.
tip_zh: 在坚持了 14 年只接受 walk-in 之后，现在可以通过 Resy/Tock 订到有限的位子。能订就订，直接去高峰期仍要等两三个小时。

name: Wildberry Pancakes & Cafe
signature: The savoury skillets, not the signature pancakes.
signature_zh: 点咸口的 skillet 铁锅，别只盯着招牌松饼
why: The most-repeated brunch recommendation on Xiaohongshu, largely because it is a two-minute walk from Millennium Park.
why_zh: 小红书上被推得最多的早午餐，很大程度上是因为它离千禧公园走路两分钟。
tip: Queue runs 20-45 minutes; no reservations. Savoury skillets get more genuine praise than the pancakes. Second Chicago location at 196 E Pearson St by Water Tower.
tip_zh: 排队 20-45 分钟，不接受预订。咸口铁锅的真实评价比松饼好。芝加哥还有第二家在 196 E Pearson St，水塔那边。

name: Girl & The Goat
signature: Shared plates. The wood-fired vegetables hold up as well as the meat.
signature_zh: 分享式小盘，柴火烤蔬菜和肉一样出色
why: The West Loop benchmark on Xiaohongshu, and the one dinner reservation most notes tell you to lock first.
why_zh: 小红书上西环的标杆，也是大多数笔记让你最先锁定的那顿晚餐。
tip: Book well ahead. Walk-in bar seating exists but goes early.
tip_zh: 提前很久订位。吧台可以 walk-in，但很早就满。

name: Momotaro
signature: Robata grill and sushi; the downstairs izakaya is the better room.
signature_zh: 炉端烧和寿司，楼下居酒屋那间氛围更好
why: Heavy Xiaohongshu coverage as the West Loop splurge.
why_zh: 小红书上西环"奢侈一顿"的常见选择，曝光很高。
caveat: Coverage runs hotter than recent reviews do. Rate this one below where Xiaohongshu puts it.
caveat_zh: 小红书的热度高于近期真实评价。建议把它的排序往下调一档。

name: The Purple Pig
signature: Mediterranean small plates; the pork and the whipped feta.
signature_zh: 地中海小盘，猪肉和打发菲达奶酪
why: On Michigan Avenue but consistently strong, which is rare for that stretch.
why_zh: 开在密歇根大道上却依然稳定好吃，这条街上很少见。
tip: Loud and lively. Not the room for a quiet dinner.
tip_zh: 很吵很热闹，不适合安静吃饭。

name: Portillo's
signature: Italian beef, dipped, plus a Chicago dog. Both in one stop.
signature_zh: 意式牛肉三明治（要 dipped）加一根芝加哥热狗，一站吃两样
why: The cheap classic. Xiaohongshu treats it as the efficient way to tick both Chicago sandwiches at once.
why_zh: 便宜的经典。小红书把它当成一次搞定两样芝加哥国民食物的高效选择。
tip: Order at the counter, it moves fast even when the line looks long.
tip_zh: 柜台点单，看着队长其实走得很快。

name: Starbucks Reserve Roastery
signature: Five floors. Go up rather than staying on the ground floor.
signature_zh: 五层楼，一定要往上走，别停在一楼
why: The world's largest Starbucks and a fixture of Xiaohongshu photo notes.
why_zh: 全球最大的星巴克，小红书打卡笔记的常驻选手。
tip: Weekdays only. On weekends the queue to get through the door is the problem, not the queue for coffee.
tip_zh: 只在工作日去。周末排的不是咖啡，是进门。

name: LH Rooftop
signature: A drink directly above the river bend.
signature_zh: 就在河湾正上方喝一杯
why: The most-cited rooftop on Xiaohongshu for the river view specifically, rather than the skyline generally.
why_zh: 小红书上被提及最多的顶楼，卖点是正对河湾，而不是泛泛的天际线。
tip: 22nd floor. It does take reservations through Tock and OpenTable and they sell out, so book rather than relying on the walk-in waitlist.
tip_zh: 22 楼。可以通过 Tock 和 OpenTable 订位，而且会订满，别只指望现场候补。
caveat: Rating is the weakest on this list. Come for the view and the drink; do not plan a meal here.
caveat_zh: 这份清单里评分最低的一个。来看景喝酒可以，别指望正经吃饭。

name: Lao Sze Chuan
signature: Sichuan. The dry chilli chicken if you order anything.
signature_zh: 川菜，真要点就点辣子鸡
why: Carries heavy legacy Xiaohongshu hype from a 2020 national ranking.
why_zh: 因为 2020 年的一个全美排名，在小红书上留下了大量旧热度。
caveat: The clearest example of stale Xiaohongshu content ranking high. Now sitting at 3.9 with service complaints. Chinatown has better options on this page.
caveat_zh: 小红书"旧笔记高排名"最典型的例子。现在只有 3.9 分，服务投诉不少。这一页里中国城有更好的选择。

name: Cloud Gate (The Bean)
signature: Walk underneath it, not just around it.
signature_zh: 一定要走到底下去，不要只绕着拍
why: The mandatory shot. The underside distorts the skyline in a way the outside surface does not.
why_zh: 必打卡。底下那个凹面对天际线的扭曲，是外面拍不到的。
tip: Early morning is the only time it is genuinely uncrowded.
tip_zh: 只有大清早才是真的不挤。

name: Art Institute of Chicago
signature: The Impressionists and the American wing: La Grande Jatte, American Gothic, Nighthawks.
signature_zh: 印象派和美国馆：大碗岛、美国哥特式、夜鹰
why: One of the few museums where the headline works are all genuinely in one building.
why_zh: 少数几个招牌作品真的都在同一栋楼里的博物馆。
tip: Closed Tuesdays. Book ahead. Half a day minimum if you want the Impressionists properly.
tip_zh: 周二闭馆。提前订票。想好好看印象派，至少留半天。

name: Skydeck Chicago (Willis Tower)
signature: 103rd floor, The Ledge glass boxes.
signature_zh: 103 层，The Ledge 玻璃盒子
why: Higher than 360, and the Ledge is the shot people actually come for.
why_zh: 比 360 高，玻璃盒子才是大家真正来拍的东西。
tip: Arrive about an hour before sunset and you get day, dusk and night in one ticket.
tip_zh: 日落前一小时到，一张票能拍到白天、黄昏和夜景。
caveat: Xiaohongshu treats this and 360 as a choice, not a pair. Doing both is the classic waste of half a day.
caveat_zh: 小红书把它和 360 当成二选一，不是都去。两个都去是最典型的浪费半天。

name: 360 CHICAGO
signature: TILT, and the half-lake view Skydeck does not have.
signature_zh: TILT 倾斜玻璃，以及西尔斯没有的半面湖景
why: Less crowded than Skydeck, and you exit straight onto the Magnificent Mile.
why_zh: 比西尔斯人少，出来就是密歇根大道。
tip: Arrive about an hour before sunset.
tip_zh: 日落前一小时到。

name: Chicago Riverwalk
signature: Walk it in the hour before sunset.
signature_zh: 日落前一小时走一遍
why: Free, and rated as highly as anything ticketed in the city.
why_zh: 免费，评分和城里任何收费景点一样高。

name: Navy Pier
signature: The skyline view back toward the city, not the pier itself.
signature_zh: 回望城市的天际线，而不是码头本身
tip: Shoot early morning or evening. Midday puts the skyline directly into backlight.
tip_zh: 早上或傍晚拍。中午天际线完全逆光。

name: Shedd Aquarium
signature: Pair it with the Field Museum; they are a two-minute walk apart.
signature_zh: 和菲尔德博物馆一起安排，走路两分钟
why: The Museum Campus skyline view at dusk is a known photo spot in its own right.
why_zh: 博物馆园区黄昏时看天际线，本身就是个知名机位。

name: Griffin Museum of Science and Industry
signature: The U-505 submarine.
signature_zh: U-505 潜艇
tip: Half a day minimum. It is a long way south, so do not tack it onto a Loop day.
tip_zh: 至少半天。位置在南边很远，别硬塞进卢普区那天。

name: Garfield Park Conservatory
why: Off most tourist lists and rated 4.8 anyway.
why_zh: 基本不在游客清单上，评分却有 4.8。
tip: Closed Monday and Tuesday. Well west of the Loop, so give it its own trip.
tip_zh: 周一周二闭馆。在卢普区以西很远，单独安排一趟。

name: Chicago Architecture River Cruise
signature: The 75-minute architecture tour, booked for roughly 30 minutes before sunset.
signature_zh: 75 分钟建筑讲解，订日落前约 30 分钟那班
why: Repeatedly called the single must-do on Xiaohongshu, above both observation decks.
why_zh: 小红书上反复被称为唯一必做项目，排在两个观景台之上。
tip: Booking just before sunset gets you daylight and night views on one ticket.
tip_zh: 订日落前那班，一张票同时看到白天和夜景。

name: Phoenix Restaurant
signature: Cantonese dim sum, pushed on carts at weekends.
signature_zh: 粤式点心，周末推车
why: Named repeatedly across Xiaohongshu Chinatown notes.
why_zh: 小红书中国城笔记里反复出现的名字。
tip: Go before 11am at weekends or the wait doubles.
tip_zh: 周末 11 点前去，晚了排队时间翻倍。

name: Ken Kee Restaurant Hong Kong
signature: Crispy pan-fried pork dumplings and Hong Kong cafe classics.
signature_zh: 脆底煎猪肉饺，以及港式茶餐厅经典
why: Listed on Xiaohongshu as 强记. The Chicago restaurant behind that name is Ken Kee.
why_zh: 小红书上写作“强记”。芝加哥这边对应的其实是 Ken Kee。
tip: Searching the Xiaohongshu romanisation 'Keung Kee' returns a Hong Kong restaurant, not this one. Search Ken Kee.
tip_zh: 按小红书上的拼写 Keung Kee 搜出来的是香港那家。搜 Ken Kee。

name: MingHin Cuisine
signature: Cantonese, dim sum.
signature_zh: 粤菜，点心
why: Widely listed, but the verdict is genuinely split.
why_zh: 出现频率很高，但评价确实两极。
caveat: At least one Xiaohongshu poster rates it explicitly not worth it against Bay Area Cantonese. Calibrate if that is your reference point. Sources also disagree on its closed days, so phone ahead.
caveat_zh: 至少有小红书博主明确说和湾区粤菜比不值。如果你的参照系是湾区，先调低预期。各来源对休息日的说法也不一致，去之前打个电话确认。

name: Grand Palace
signature: Five-spice duck, shrimp in salted duck egg yolk, wontons. Late-night dim sum.
signature_zh: 五香鸭、咸蛋黄虾、云吞，深夜还有点心
why: The highest-rated Cantonese room in Chinatown, and it sits a few blocks south of the Wentworth strip most visitors never leave.
why_zh: 中国城评分最高的粤菜，位置在 Wentworth 那条街再往南几个街区，大部分游客不会走到。
tip: South of the main Wentworth/Archer cluster, so it stays quieter than the places on the gate strip.
tip_zh: 在 Wentworth/Archer 主街区以南，比牌坊那条街上的店安静不少。

name: Xi'an Cuisine
signature: Rou jia mo, cumin lamb flatbread, biang biang noodles, lamb soup.
signature_zh: 肉夹馍、孜然羊肉饼、biangbiang 面、羊肉汤
why: Shaanxi street food, and the main reason to come to Chinatown if you have already eaten Cantonese.
why_zh: 陕西小吃。如果粤菜已经吃过了，这家就是再来中国城的理由。
tip: BYO. Reviews split on the soup broth; the flatbreads and rou jia mo are the consistent praise.
tip_zh: 可以自带酒水。汤的评价两极，但饼和肉夹馍是公认的稳。

name: Gao's BBQ & Crab
signature: Lamb, beef and tofu-skin skewers, grilled oysters, dan dan noodles.
signature_zh: 羊肉串、牛肉串、豆皮串、烤生蚝、担担面
why: The late-night skewer stop Xiaohongshu notes point to when everything else in Chinatown has shut.
why_zh: 小红书笔记里中国城“别的都关了”之后去的那家烧烤。
tip: Very busy at weekends.
tip_zh: 周末非常忙。

name: Tiger Sugar
signature: Brown sugar boba milk tea.
signature_zh: 黑糖珍珠鲜奶
why: The boba name that carried over from Xiaohongshu Chinatown notes.
why_zh: 小红书中国城笔记里一路带过来的奶茶名字。
caveat: Rated 3.8, well below the other Chinatown boba options, with a recent hygiene complaint the owner answered publicly. Kung Fu Tea and Uni Uni both sit at 4.4 on the same street.
caveat_zh: 3.8 分，明显低于中国城其他奶茶店，最近还有卫生投诉、老板公开回应过。同一条街上的 Kung Fu Tea 和 Uni Uni 都是 4.4。
